newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Liquide joins venture to supply AMD in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide joins venture to supply AMD in Germany.

text.p: Chemicals group Air Liquide said its German subsidiary Air Liquide GmbH had joined a venture as part of a contract signed with U.S. semiconductor company Advanced Micro Devices Inc on Thursday to supply its plant in Dresden.

The contract is for long-term supply of ultra-pure gases needed in the production of semiconductors and also ultra-pure electricity -- extremely stable electricity with no micro-interruptions of power -- through a venture with Dresden Elektrizitaet und Fernwaerme GmbH (DEF) and Meissner+Wurst GmbH, Air Liquide said in a statement.
It said it would own 40 percent of the venture, DEF 50 percent and Meissner+Wurst 10 percent.
Air Liquide GmbH will invest around $30 million, it said.
Deliveries of the gases and electricity are set to begin in October.
